messages:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — microbench shows a 12-18% throughput regression when epilogue-fusion is enabled on the FlashAttn variant for long contexts with paged KV. Dropping the main numbers and a few traces here. :face_with_monocle:

Ben: uhoh. can you paste the exact benchmark command and the perf deltas?

Sasha: `./bench --model llama-13b --seq 4096 --batch 4 --paged-kv --fuse-epilogue=on --qkv-pack=auto`
nsys summary (avg of 50 iters):
- step_time: 120.4ms (no-fuse) -> 140.7ms (fuse-on)
- fused_epilogue_kernel: 42.3ms -> 50.1ms
- attention_core: 28.2ms -> 29.8ms
- observed throughput drop ~14%

Vikram: is this on A100 or H100? what driver / cuda?

Sasha: A100 40GB, driver 525.85, CUDA 11.8. nvprof/nsys trace shows L2 writeback spikes when fuse-on + paged-kv. flame graph attributes more time to the epilogue path (memcopy / scatter) rather than matmul.

Kai: interesting — sounds like epilogue fusion is producing uncoalesced device writes when paged-kv causes more page churn. our kernel-selector currently picks fused-epilogue for seq >= 1024 and qkv-pack=auto, but it doesn't consider paged-kv heuristics.

Ben: can we see the kernel launch params (grid/block/smem) for the fused epilogue kernel?

Sasha: snippet from the profiler: `kernel fused_epilogue <<<grid=(896,1,1), block=(256,1,1)>>>, smem=48KB, registers=64, prefetch_window=8`
Additional counters: `L2_wr_mem_ctrl_wb` spikes + page-cache hit ~0.68 during high churn runs.

Vikram: @Sasha can you try `--kv-page-size=2MB` and `--fuse-epilogue=heuristic-v2`? heuristic-v2 has the livepatch fallback: if L2 miss rate > 15% or estimated page_churn > threshold it falls back to non-fused epilogue.

Sasha: running that now. also tried `--qkv-pack=off` to isolate. Preliminary results:
- heuristic-v2 + paged-kv: step_time 118.6ms (back to baseline)
- qkv-pack toggle had negligible effect (~1% delta)
So disabling epilogue fusion via the heuristic brings throughput back.

Kai: that points to epilogue fusion increasing write amplification under paged-kv. plan: update kernel selector to include `paged_kv` flag and `estimated_page_churn` when scoring fused vs unfused epilogue. also add a small microbench to calibrate the L2 miss threshold (we saw 15% as the breakpoint here).

Ben: agreed. PR should include: selector change, a unit-test microbench that simulates page churn (synthetic host->device scatter), and a documented fallback metric. @infra-bot can we schedule a canary run on dedicated pool after the change? :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-canary triggered — canary-id=canary-2026-03-18-42 scheduled to eng-runtime-dedicated in ~30m.

Sasha: thanks all — i'll open an issue with the nsys traces + nvprof output and link the PR. will attach the raw `.qdrep` and the kernel CSV.

Ben: one more ask — can we add a lightweight trace in the runtime that emits `paged_kv_page_churn_estimate` and `epilogue_write_coalesce_ratio` to console/debug metrics? would help future debugging.

Kai: yep, add as token-level debug fields and surface in per-route perf dashboard (low overhead counters).

Sasha: done — added notes to the issue. thanks.
